annotations.title: Get industry payments to a doctor

description: Gets the general payments that drug and device companies reported to CMS Open Payments for one doctor, by 10-digit NPI. Returns totals by program year and by company, with the payment types, and the doctor's Medicare Part D prescriptions of drugs named in those payments where the files have them. A payment is not a sign of wrongdoing. The overlap with prescriptions does not show that a payment changed a prescription.
name: get_doctor_payments
title: Get industry payments to a doctor
